runtime.actual: Onboarding and Home were rendered. No real notifications, sharing, purchases, destructive actions, personal data, or native sensor/audio behavior was invoked.

checks.expected: Exactly 8 calculation methods are available and each method is represented in the prayer configuration path.
checks.actual: CALC_METHODS contains 8 entries: 16,4,8,3,2,1,5,13; architecture test passed 3/3 runs using mocked provider/cache paths.

checks.expected: 05:00 and 12:05 format correctly in 12-hour and 24-hour modes.
checks.actual: formatTime returned 12:05 PM, 12:05 AM for 00:05, and unchanged 12:05 in 24h mode.

checks.expected: After Isha, next prayer is tomorrow Fajr.
checks.actual: getNextPrayer returned null at 21:00 for schedule with Isha 20:00; source explicitly returns null after Isha instead of tomorrow Fajr.

checks.expected: 30 deterministic dates equal Intl Umm al-Qura day/month/year with no undefined.
checks.actual: 30/30 matched; no undefined values. Boundary dates and 29/30-day month behavior were covered by the regression suite.

checks.expected: Gold nisab 85g, silver nisab 595g, 2.5% of eligible net wealth, liabilities subtracted and clamped at zero.
checks.actual: USD fixture: gold threshold 6630, net 10000, due 250; liability fixture: net 6000 and due 0.

checks.expected: Dubai, London, Karachi, New York bearings within 2 degrees.
checks.actual: All four bearings matched expected values within 2 degrees.

checks.expected: Deterministic consecutive-day Salah and fasting streak fixtures, including gaps and today/yesterday rollover, pass.
checks.actual: Production helpers were not exercised with injectable clock/storage fixtures; source computeStreak sorts all keys and stops on the first incomplete day, while fasting streak uses real Date, so full correctness remains unverified.

checks.expected: Increment, daily aggregation, reset, and persistence survive reopen.
checks.actual: No deterministic production storage round-trip was run; native haptic/audio side effects are device-dependent and were not called.

checks.expected: Summary fields exactly equal seeded seven-day reading, salah, hifz, and notes fixtures.
checks.actual: No seeded production AsyncStorage/SQLite fixture was installed; UI summary was not reached in the deployed session.

checks.expected: 14,000+ unique records; search <300 ms; filters/index/favorites persist across reopen.
checks.actual: Static bundled list is 99 records (NAMES_99); NamesScreen filters transliteration/meaning/name/note/number but no 14,000+ dataset or favorites persistence evidence was found in this audit.
